basic_info.description: Marcus & Millichap presents a rare opportunity to acquire 1501-1519 Polk Street, a landmark mixed-use property nestled in San Francisco's prestigious Nob Hill neighborhood. Gracing the iconic California Street Cable Car line, this 34-unit building, offered for the first time in over four decades, seamlessly blends historical character with modern convenience. Anchored by the legendary Swan Oyster Depot, a culinary institution since 1912, the property enjoys unparalleled visibility and a vibrant tenant mix. Above the bustling retail spaces, 29 residential units - a mix of studios and one-bedrooms - cater to the city's discerning residents. With recent capital improvements, including a new roof (2018) and upcoming electrical upgrades, this legacy property offers both immediate stability and significant long-term value appreciation potential.  Probate sale may be subject to court confirmation.  Must include probate addendum.
